character: Lower entrance to Val d'Isère. La Folie Douce at the top of the Daille bubble. More residential and practical than central Val. Supermarket, sports shops, bakery. Shuttle central. Good-value accommodation.
dining: La Folie Douce dining venues (La Fruitière, La Petite Cuisine, La Cucùcina — Italian gourmet). Le Barillon (family-run, popular with locals). Pizz'n'Love.
activities_nearby: Daille bubble up to La Folie Douce and Espace Killy. Free shuttle to Val centre (5 min).
